payload.summary: Owner to accept the Supabase data processing agreement before 1 Dec 2026 (SB-10)
payload.detail: No Supabase DPA is recorded (docs/privacy-impact-assessment.md section 7). Only the owner can accept legal terms: Supabase dashboard, Organisation, Legal documents. Then record the date in the assessment and docs/rag-improvement/data-flow-register.md. The live privacy page does not claim a DPA exists, so the page needs no change.
